as_told.place_text: Naval War College, Newport, Rhode Island; motel (possibly Tennessee)

plain: Duncan Laurie, a researcher, tells of a man named John Norseen, linked to the Naval War College, a US Navy school in Newport, Rhode Island, who sent him an email in the early 2000s using the phrase "not heard nor seen". Laurie says that just about two weeks later Norseen was found dead in a motel room. If the two are connected, it would suggest Norseen knew something dangerous.
